title: Nekta Typeface Showcase
coreRelationships: The large, bold 'Nekta' typeface dominates the lower half of the composition, contrasting with the smaller, more conventional text at the top.
The vibrant blue background provides a high-contrast canvas for the black and cream text and logo elements.
The circular 'Zarma Type' logo acts as a distinct, lighter accent against the dark 'Nekta' text.
The top-left text block establishes the brand and purpose, while the top-right text provides additional font details.
The bottom-right copyright information anchors the composition.
reuseFormula: Adopt a vibrant, solid blue background. Place a large, chunky, black sans-serif typeface name centrally in the lower half. Position smaller, black sans-serif descriptive text in the top-left. Include a cream-colored oval/circular logo with black text near the main typeface name. Add a small, black copyright notice in the bottom-right. Maintain significant negative space throughout.
